problem.title: A 305-edge C4-free subgraph of the seven-dimensional hypercube
problem.statement: Construct at least 305 distinct lexicographically ordered Q7 edges with no four-cycle, without odd-square, degree, orbit, bipartition, or symmetry restrictions.
problem.quantifiers: there exists a C4-free edge subset of Q7 with at least 305 edges
problem.domain: the 448 oriented edges of the 128-vertex seven-dimensional hypercube
conventions: u<v and popcount(u xor v)=1; every C4 is one of 672 two-dimensional faces
completion_criteria: Supply at least 305 valid distinct lexicographically ordered edges and leave every one of the 672 faces with at most three selected edges.
sources: OP-000007 frozen card and R06-R09 snapshots dated 2026-10-26; refresh within 24 hours before launch

formal_scope: Formal OP-000007 submission: 305..448 lexicographic Q7 edges and all 672 two-dimensional faces; a program pass is a candidate pending scientific review.
research_scope: Research-only Q7 baseline or partial witness: 0..304 lexicographic C4-free edges and all 672 faces; never a formal 305 submission or a global exclusion.

success.meaning: ex(Q7,C4)>=305 candidate only; exact extremum remains undetermined

public_baselines.claim: official v5 leaves global ex(Q7,C4)=304 open; g(7)=304 is odd-square only; global lower bound 304
public comment derives upper bound 308 by subcube averaging; not treated as a peer-reviewed new theorem
reported local exchange exclusions and annealing failures are limited and unreplayed

local_goal_gate.requirements: non-duplicate of public SAT/ILP, local exchange and catalogue attacks; not limited to odd-square; independently auditable coverage and relevance to the unrestricted 305 target

stop_rules: do not start a model run without the expert local-goal gate
stop after a 305 candidate and receipt; do not claim exact extremum
304, odd-square bounds, local failures, UNKNOWN and timeout never imply global nonexistence
first exhausted frozen budget stops scheduling without retry or transfer
source conflict or equivalent public result pauses for scientific review
identity, integrity, network, authorization or protocol failure stops and isolates the run
recovery is read-only and never resumes in-flight inference
